error.message: The PIN you used has ended. Enter a new PIN to continue.
Enter a PIN or sign in first.

notes: folder_name is the folder the PIN sends into, null while the server has only one folder. shows_folder: the PIN also shows what is in its folder, so the session may use GET /api/folders, /api/library, /api/files, /api/files/ids, /api/files/{id} with its content and thumbnail, and ZIPs (/api/downloads), all for that folder only; without it they answer 403 forbidden. folder_key is the newest version of the folder's key whenever it has one: {"folder", "version", "public_key", "signature": by the newest root (contract/crypto/sign.json), "encrypted": whether new files must be encrypted}; null for a folder that was never encrypted. roots is the chain of roots, the first first, as in GET /api/keys. A guest whose PIN link names the root (/#<code>.<fingerprint>, or the root locked with a showing PIN's secret, GET /api/pin/keys) follows the chain from it, checks the key's signature, and then always sends encrypted for it, never plain; a guest who typed the code encrypts when encrypted says so.
